005package org.wpilib.math.controller;
006
007import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation3d;
008import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Translation3d;
009import org.wpilib.math.kinematics.ChassisVelocities;
010
011/**
012 * {@code AntiTipping} provides a proportional correction system to prevent the robot from tipping
013 * over during operation.
014 *
015 * <p>It uses pitch and roll measurements to detect excessive inclination and computes a correction
016 * velocity in the opposite direction of the tilt. The resulting correction can be added to the
017 * robot’s translational velocity to help stabilize it.
018 *
019 * <h2>Usage</h2>
020 *
021 * <ol>
022 *   <li>Instantiate with initial configuration parameters.
023 *   <li>Call {@link #calculate(Rotation3d)} periodically (e.g. once per control loop).
024 *   <li>Add the resulting correction to your drive command.
025 * </ol>
026 *
027 * <h2>Tuning</h2>
028 *
029 * <p>All three parameters depend on the robot's center of gravity and drivetrain, so they are best
030 * found empirically:
031 *
032 * <ul>
033 *   <li>{@code tippingThreshold}: Drive the robot normally, including hard acceleration, braking,
034 *       and turning, and record the largest pitch/roll magnitude observed. Set the threshold a few
035 *       degrees above that worst case so normal driving does not trigger a correction, but well
036 *       below the angle at which the robot actually tips.
037 *   <li>{@code kp}: The correction speed is {@code kp * sin(θ)}, so {@code kp} controls how
038 *       aggressively the robot drives out from under a tilt. Start small and increase until
039 *       recovery is brisk without overshooting or oscillating.
040 *   <li>{@code maxCorrectionSpeed}: Cap the correction at a fraction of the drivetrain's maximum
041 *       speed so the anti-tip response stays controllable and never overpowers the driver.
042 * </ul>
043 */
044public class AntiTipping {
045  private double m_tippingThreshold;
046  private double m_maxCorrectionSpeed;
047  private double m_kp;
048
049  /**
050   * Creates a new {@code AntiTipping} instance.
051   *
052   * @param kp The proportional coefficient in meters per second. The P controller input is the sine
053   *     of the inclination angle, and the output is in meters per second.
054   * @param tippingThreshold Tipping detection threshold in radians.
055   * @param maxCorrectionSpeed Maximum correction velocity in meters per second.
056   */
057  public AntiTipping(double kp, double tippingThreshold, double maxCorrectionSpeed) {
058    m_kp = kp;
059    m_tippingThreshold = tippingThreshold;
060    m_maxCorrectionSpeed = maxCorrectionSpeed;
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Sets the Proportional coefficient.
065   *
066   * @param kp The proportional coefficient in meters per second.
067   */
068  public void setP(double kp) {
069    m_kp = kp;
070  }
071
072  /**
073   * Gets the Proportional coefficient.
074   *
075   * @return The proportional coefficient in meters per second.
076   */
077  public double getP() {
078    return m_kp;
079  }
080
081  /**
082   * Sets the tipping detection threshold.
083   *
084   * @param threshold The tipping threshold in radians.
085   */
086  public void setTippingThreshold(double threshold) {
087    m_tippingThreshold = threshold;
088  }
089
090  /**
091   * Gets the tipping detection threshold.
092   *
093   * @return The tipping threshold in radians.
094   */
095  public double getTippingThreshold() {
096    return m_tippingThreshold;
097  }
098
099  /**
100   * Sets the maximum correction velocity.
101   *
102   * @param speed The maximum correction speed in meters per second.
103   */
104  public void setMaxCorrectionSpeed(double speed) {
105    m_maxCorrectionSpeed = speed;
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * Gets the maximum correction velocity.
110   *
111   * @return The maximum correction speed in meters per second.
112   */
113  public double getMaxCorrectionSpeed() {
114    return m_maxCorrectionSpeed;
115  }
116
117  /**
118   * Updates tipping detection and computes the proportional correction.
119   *
120   * @param attitude Current robot attitude as a {@link Rotation3d}.
121   * @return Correction {@link ChassisVelocities} to counteract tipping. Returns zeros if below
122   *     threshold.
123   */
124  public ChassisVelocities calculate(Rotation3d attitude) {
125    // To find the correction, we rotate the z axis (scaled by the P gain) by the attitude, then
126    // project onto the x-y plane.
127    var correction = new Translation3d(0.0, 0.0, m_kp).rotateBy(attitude).toTranslation2d();
128    double norm = correction.getNorm();
129
130    // Let inclination angle of 3D correction be θ.
131    //
132    //    _o_       +z
133    //    \  |       ^
134    //   h \θ|       |
135    //      \|  +x <--
136    //
137    // where o is length of 2D correction and h is length of 3D correction.
138    //
139    //   sinθ = o/h
140    //   θ = asin(norm / m_kp)
141    double inclinationAngle = Math.asin(norm / m_kp);
142
143    if (inclinationAngle < m_tippingThreshold) {
144      return new ChassisVelocities(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
145    } else if (norm > m_maxCorrectionSpeed) {
146      // Clamp the correction to the maximum correction speed
147      correction = correction.times(m_maxCorrectionSpeed / norm);
148    }
149
150    return new ChassisVelocities(correction.getX(), correction.getY(), 0.0);
151  }
152}
